title: Seeing Louis Armstrong twice in New Orleans
summary: Asked about Louis Armstrong, he says he met him only after Armstrong came back, seeing him at the auditorium and the Gypsy Tea Room, around the war years.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: Did you ever know kid Louis Armstrong Thomas?

I met him, but I never knowed him before, you know what I mean? When did he? Until he came here. He came, you know, when he went off and came back to the play. He played over there in Old River. And I saw him twice.
And once at the Gypsy Tea Room.
Oh, he came to the Gypsy Tea Room, huh?
Mm-hmm. Man, that must have been, it must have been around, way around, all the days or something. Mm-hmm.
